title: Setup: build Spring Boot #52824 (S23) at both pins and run its landed tests
description: Setup job for llm-dlc/loops/spring-boot-merged-pr-links-s01-s50-brief.md, case S23 (spring-projects/spring-boot#52824: A secondary entity manager rolls back flushed inserts in its own pool). In the worktrees $P/worktrees/S23-{fix,parent} (P = ~/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-boot-pr-links-s01-s50), offline (dependencies resolved online beforehand), it builds the jars of module:spring-boot-hibernate with the Gradle each checkout's wrapper names on JDK 25, runs the landed test classes (HibernateJpaAutoConfigurationTests (test) ) at the fix and those of them that exist at the parent, keeps the jars, SHA256SUMS (jars and every class of the changed production sources) and the runtime and test runtime classpaths of module:spring-boot-hibernate in $P/artifacts/S23-ROLE, then runs the fix's changed test files on a copy of the parent, where they are expected to fail or not compile, and removes the build trees. Script: $P/scripts/case_job.sh. No claims, no verifier.
expected: every step exits 0: fix and parent BUILD SUCCESSFUL with failures=0 errors=0 for the landed classes; transplant prints TRANSPLANT-FAILS-AS-EXPECTED or TRANSPLANT-DOES-NOT-COMPILE-AS-EXPECTED; clean prints cleaned S23

resources.notes: Gradle daemon -Xmx3g with the Kotlin compiler in process, plus test JVMs; buildSrc and gradle/plugins compile once per worktree and once in the transplant copy (about 1 min each)

steps.name: S23 fix: build and landed tests
S23 parent: build and the parent's tests
S23 transplant: the fix's tests on the parent
